# Elah

> Elah builds Node, a personal AI device that lives with you, not in a data center. The AI inside Node is called Samantha. Node is designed to run on hardware you own, with no usage limits and no per-word metering. Elah is also designing its own AI silicon for personal AI.

Elah is an early-stage company. Node is in development and has not shipped; no price or ship date has been announced. The "Meet Samantha" film on the website is a concept film made with an interface prototype and scripted responses.

## Status (November 2026)

- Interface prototype: working
- Hardware prototype: in progress
- Elah's own AI silicon: in research
- First business pilot: in discussion
- Ship date: not announced

## What Node is designed to do

- Run a personal AI on a device in your home or office, so conversations, files and memories stay there.
- Work without tokens, credits or a usage meter.
- Keep working when the internet is down.
- Keep a memory you can see, edit, delete and export.
- Plan, write, create images, help with code, and run helper agents in the background.
- Offer private, on-site AI pilots for businesses with data they can't upload.

- [Node](https://elah.one/node): what Samantha does, what works today versus what's in development, and an FAQ.

- [Careers](https://elah.one/careers): Elah is hiring a founding System Architecture Engineer (photonics, neuromorphic computing, AI/ML). Remote, US company, founding equity. Includes an optional hiring side quest.

- [Early access](https://elah.one/access): sign up as a buyer, business, investor or builder.

## Name

Elah takes its name from the Valley of Elah, where a shepherd with a sling faced a giant.
